faq.a: After payment you receive an order ID and a tracking link. Open arafatbin.com/track/, enter the order ID and the last 4 digits of your phone number (or your email) to see the status of your order.

faq.q: Where do I find my Netflix ID and password?
faq.a: You get the login email by email after your payment is confirmed. There is no password to remember: you sign in with a one-time code that we send you when you ask for it.

faq.q: How do I download the official Netflix app on any device?
faq.a: Get Netflix only from the official store of your device: App Store (iPhone, iPad), Google Play (Android), Microsoft Store (Windows) or the app store of your smart TV. Search for "Netflix" and install the app published by Netflix, Inc.

faq.q: How do I update the Netflix app?
faq.a: Open the same app store (App Store, Google Play, Microsoft Store or your TV’s store), search for Netflix and tap Update. You can also turn on automatic updates in the store settings.

faq.q: How do I sign in to Netflix with an email code and no password?
faq.a: Open the Netflix app, enter your login email and choose "Use a sign-in code" instead of a password. Then ask us for the code in the live chat, on WhatsApp or by email, and type it in the app.

faq.q: How do I contact the administrator of this page or product?
faq.a: Use the live chat on any page, WhatsApp, email or the contact page (arafatbin.com/contact/). We usually reply within minutes.

faq.q: How do I use the live chat?
faq.a: Tap the blue chat button at the bottom right of any page of arafatbin.com, type your message and we answer in the same window.

faq.q: What is a Netflix personal profile?
faq.a: A personal profile is your own space on the Netflix account, with your name, watch history, My List and recommendations. We lock it with your 4-digit PIN so only you can open it.

faq.q: What is a Netflix Kids profile?
faq.a: A Kids profile shows only content for children. On our accounts it is left unlocked so you can test that Netflix plays well on your device before we set up your personal profile.

faq.q: What is the refund and return policy for this product?
faq.a: Test the account on the Kids profile first. If something does not work and we cannot fix it, you get a full refund within a few days. After your personal profile is set up, we fix any problem during your subscription. See our refund policy page for details.

faq.q: Can I test before final activation?

faq.q: Can I add my own picture to my Netflix profile?
faq.a: Netflix does not allow uploading your own photo. You can choose any of the profile icons Netflix offers, and we can set your favourite one for you.

faq.q: I forgot my Netflix profile PIN or login email. What now?
faq.a: Contact us in the live chat or on WhatsApp with your order ID. We send you the login email again and reset your profile PIN.
